demographic

demographic groups elements describing demographic characteristics of the participants in a linguistic interaction.
Member of classes (none)  
Members affiliation birth education firstLang langKnown occupation persName residence socecStatus
Declaration 
<!ENTITY % x.demographic "" >
<!ENTITY % m.demographic "%x.demographic; %n.affiliation; | %n.birth; | 
%n.education; | %n.firstLang; | %n.langKnown; | %n.occupation; | %n.persName; | 
%n.residence; | %n.socecStatus;">
Attributes Global attributes only
Note

This class is used to define the content model for the <person> and <personGrp> elements.
Module Declared in file teiclas2.ent; Core tag sets: enabled when any TEI base is enabled
